name: cz-sk-company-info
title: CZ/SK Company Info — Free IČO Lookup
description: Look up Czech and Slovak companies by IČO. Combines MSP, ARES, finstat.sk and RPO into one JSON: identification, NACE, statutory body and shareholders (CZ), 5-year financial history (SK), insolvency flag, VAT status. No API key. For B2B prospecting, KYC, due diligence, CRM enrichment.
